scripts.dev: bun scripts/run-with-local-database-url.ts bunx turbo run dev:bare -F web -F @functhis/mcp --parallel
scripts.postinstall: tsc -b packages/api && varlock codegen --path ./apps/web/ && varlock codegen --path ./packages/db/ && bun run cf-typegen
scripts.test: bun test packages/auth apps/mcp/src scripts apps/web/src/lib/auth apps/web/src/lib/errors apps/web/src/lib/query apps/web/src/routes/d/-lib && bun run --filter functhis test && bun run --filter @functhis/publish test && bun run --filter @functhis/runtime test
scripts.test:integration: docker compose up -d postgres && bun tests/integration/scripts/migrate.ts && bun run --filter @functhis/integration-tests test:integration
scripts.dev:web: bun scripts/run-with-local-database-url.ts bunx turbo run dev:bare -F web --
scripts.check: bun run env:generate && ultracite check && knip
scripts.check:staged: bun run ultracite:staged && bun run knip
scripts.example:hello:deploy: bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts publish --slug hello-world --project-root examples/hello-world --url http://localhost:3001
scripts.example:monorepo:deploy: bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts publish --slug demo-functions --project-root examples/monorepo/packages/demo-functions --url http://localhost:3001
scripts.precommit: bun run check && bun run check-types --filter='...[HEAD]' && bun run test
